Players Committee card image of [[Ric In Queen's Royal Starship (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “May add 1 pilot and 5 passengers. Permanent pilot is •Ric, who provides ability of 3. R2-D2 deploys -2 aboard. While We'll Need a New One on table, adds one battle destiny. Immune to attrition < 5.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/ricinqueensroyalstarship.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/53572eb94d14c4f21f0f3396874727653397c6e8 53572eb] (16 August 2023). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
